scope: First pair of real p-up/local-h candidates from the frozen 180-cell p3 parent; no candidate PDE results existed when this record was written.

parent.control: 6x10x6 p6 excluded from marking and ranking

metric_contract.J_infinity: max_j(d_j/tau_j), using the complete frozen observable vector and reference/incident floors
metric_contract.inventory: 612 individual channel powers, R/T/A_volume, R00_s/R00_p/R00_total, four complete complex boundary-amplitude groups, total/scattered E/H volume norms and G
metric_contract.shared_rule: parent and candidate recomputed on one common q8 union-of-actual-leaf-breakpoints rule; reuse requires matching physical points, weights and full field identity
metric_contract.q8_scope: Affine N1curl p<=6 squared E/curl differences have per-axis polynomial degree<=12, within Gauss-8 exactness; measured q8/q10 calibration retained. PDE q15/q28 and R13/R14 checks are separate pending final qualification.

initial_measured_noise.interpretation: Observed initial sensitivities, not rigorous bounds. Factor 2 is frozen conservatively for two-state comparisons before candidate results. Repeat tighter-solve and quadrature checks near final tolerance.

ranking.tie_when_intervals_overlap: smaller measured candidate-specific full-path wall time, then fewer actual independent FE dofs, then lexical candidate_id
ranking.candidate_specific_full_path: planning/closure/transfer + monitored solve/recovery/output + candidate-specific comparison; shared reference work counted once in campaign cost and excluded equally from both tie-break times

stop_and_review: Do not silently change metrics, reference, tolerance or noise calibration after seeing candidate results. Preserve failures and follow task.md repair/bootstrap rules.
